name: Mindhunger
summary: Deathleaper/Lictor/Neurolictor units gain Deep Strike. Lictor/Neurolictor attacks against a Character unit can re-roll hit rolls of 1.

name: Feed the Swarm
summary: Each Command phase, every Harvester unit can regenerate one nearby (6in) friendly Tyranids unit once per phase: heal D3+1 wounds on a model, or return one destroyed Infantry model (up to 3 for an Endless Multitude unit).

name: Enraged Behemoths
summary: A Tyranids Monster below Starting Strength gets +1 to Hit; if also Below Half-strength, +1 to Wound too. A non-Battle-shocked Monster unit at full strength gets +2 Objective Control.

name: Hyper-adaptations
summary: On battle round 1, pick one Hyper-adaptation for the whole battle: Sustained Hits 1 vs Infantry/Swarm, Lethal Hits vs Monster/Vehicle, or Precision on a Critical Hit vs Character.

name: Surprise Assault
summary: Tyranids re-roll a Hit roll of 1. Burrower units (Mawloc/Trygon) arriving from Reserves place a Tunnel Marker; later Reserves can deep-set near it. Up to 2 Trygons can be made Characters (Warlord-eligible).

name: Synaptic Imperatives
summary: Each battle round, pick one Synaptic Imperative for units in Synapse Range: a 5+ invulnerable save, +1 to Advance/Charge rolls, or +1 to melee Hit rolls, active until round end.

name: Higher Imperatives
summary: Once per battle per unit, in your Command phase, a Norn Emissary/Norn Assimilator can re-select its Singular Purpose ability, replacing its previous choice.

name: Questing Tendrils
summary: Tyranids with this ability can charge after falling back; Vanguard Invader units with it can also charge after advancing.

name: Leader-beasts
summary: Ranged/melee Tyranid Warriors gain the Tyranid Warriors and Battleline keywords. Tyranid Warriors/Prime with Lash Whip, and Winged Prime, get a 5+ invulnerable save.
